windows.title: Time windows
windows.description: A time window sets another limit for certain days and hours. Outside every window the limit above applies.
windows.applies: The limit that applies when a run starts is used for that whole run. A window that begins or ends during a run does not change it.
windows.rules: A window starts at its start time and ends just before its end time. An end that is not after the start ends on the next day; the same time twice makes a window of 24 hours. Windows must not overlap, but one can start where another ends.
windows.zone: Times are read in {zone}, the time zone of the schedule.
windows.empty: No time windows: the limit above applies at all times.
windows.daysHint: A window that runs past midnight belongs to the day it starts on.

hooks.warningTitle: These commands run with full rights
hooks.warningRoot: Each agent runs them as root (administrator) on its machine, before and after every backup. Only enter commands you trust and understand.
hooks.warningMachines: A machine runs them only if its own administrator allowed hooks on it: none, only named scripts from /etc/restow-agent/hooks.d, or any command. A machine that does not allow them refuses the change.
hooks.warningFailure: If the command before the backup fails, the backup fails too.
hooks.stepUp: Setting or changing a hook asks you to confirm it is you when you signed in more than 10 minutes ago.
hooks.hidden: The commands of this job are hidden for your role and cannot be changed here.
